content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?The Chosen's PostThe Chosen Verified accountSeptember 16, 2025 · Shared with PublicSeason 6 is a wrap, and we’re already reminiscing. These photos from Seasons 1-6 have us feeling nostalgic.+2All reactions:59K2.8K comments2.3K sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Teresa MartosThis series is addicting!!! I have watched 1-3 twice and 4 & 5 once. Ready to watch it all over againIt is amazing that I see myself in these characters and have learned things along the way. Very happy to be blessed to enjoy such an awesome production. I ask people often if they have seen it, adding to have tissue readily available cuz it will be needed. I cry many tears throughout all of it. The right words for Jonathon Roumie is difficult to express. He is INCREDIBLE to watch. I understand why people get emotional when meeting/see him, I would probably break down too Watching the crucifixion is going to take me over the edge, I already know it.This is not just a "series" this is REAL.The cast, directors, producers, etc have really blessed us with this powerful show. Thank YOU Jesus for giving such great talent, skill and wisdom to have this created for us to enjoy 30w123The Chosen replied · 17 RepliesMelvin WilliamsAbsolutely the best show ever.
